_comment: RULE 5 offensive-tooling signatures for Find-TrustAbuse.ps1. Kept in this DATA file (not in the .ps1) so the detector does not carry verbatim Mimikatz command strings that AMSI/EDR would quarantine on load - see Find-SkeletonKey.signatures.json for the rationale. The tool reads this as data at run time; if it is missing, RULE 5 is skipped and the trust-object rules (1-4) still run. The benign-admin trust tools (netdom, .NET SetSidFilteringStatus, Set-ADObject) are detected inline in the tool itself - only the AV-sensitive offensive tokens live here.
